name: agent-handoff
description: Two-agent relay over the blackboard handoff thread (ADR-016, ticket 14.2): a researcher agent's turn is auto-appended to the run thread and a pinned handoff payload; the writer agent's role carries a 'conversation view' context preset (the thread + the pinned handoff), so the researcher's findings reach the writer automatically without the writer's task naming them. Runs offline on the mock provider — the mock echoes the assembled context, so the writer's output carries the researcher's finding.

researcher.system: You are a researcher. Gather the key facts for the given topic and state them plainly.

writer.system: You are a writer. Turn the research thread into a short article; rely only on the conversation and the pinned handoff.

config.prompt: Research this topic and report the findings: ${{ run.params.topic }}
Write a short article from the research conversation above.
